title.narrative: Promoting Sustainable and Integrated Urbanisation Processes in Senegal and the Gambia

description.narrative:
The project “Promoting Sustainable and Integrated Urbanisation Processes in Senegal and Gambia” is developed to promote sustainable and integrated urbanisation processes in Senegal and Gambia. Through its priorities the project aligns with with the United Nations New Urban Agenda and UN-Habitat Strategic Plan 2020-2025, particularly prioritizing the dimension of social inclusion. This dimension is critical for the fulfilment of the commitment under the 2023 Agenda for Sustainable Development that emphasizes that no one should be left behind and focuses on working towards a world in which everyone can benefit from the advantages of sustainable urbanisation.
The emphasis of the project lies particularly in two parts: 1. On contributing to the development of an inclusive and integrated National Urban Policy under the National Development Plan (NDP) directive issued to review all the existing Local Government Area (LGA) strategic plans in Senegal, and 2. On conducting a Strategic Spatial Analysis in Gambia to promote inter-country cooperation. As indicated by the title of the project, the geography of the project is limited to Senegal and Gambia. The overall objective of the project includes providing key policy and strategic tools to the governments of Senegal and Gambia to better guide the urbanisation processes, and promote coherent, strategic investments, and greater inter-country cooperation. In this regard, the project aims to determine the interdependence of the two countries and develop a common spatial development strategy that would reinforce their cooperation and mutual development. This process would include utilizing the SDF to define key corridors, growth poles and areas of investment.
To achieve this goal, UN-Habitat will work in close cooperation with both governments, build institutional capacities, and develop relevant policy and strategic decision-making tools. Through these contributions, the project will ensure that the national bodies are not only able to lead the preparation but also own them and better guide urbanisation and sustainable development processes in Senegal and Gambia.
